label: AI Insight UI — Data Sources
info: Pure UIBUILDER data-sources subflow per FAP §10. Receives FAP §9 commands from the dispatcher's link-to-data-sources and routes by msg._req.action. Synthesises a list of FACIS data sources from the simulation feeds tab's last-known feed snapshots in the shared Node-RED global context (global.latest_meters / latest_pv / latest_weather / latest_price / latest_consumers — populated by tab-feeds in the same orce pod, per docs/flow-architecture.md §72) plus a static row for the SFTP DSP drop channel. No HTTP fan-out — fully aligned with ADR-001 (pure UIBUILDER for SPA channels).
